## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

## Ref: EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Signatures of attendees
- Date of briefing
- Content of briefing, which shall include as a minimum:
- Key membersoftheContractors team
- Emaar Misr Program H&S Policy and commitment to Beyond Zero site details including layout and welfare facilities
- Communication, consultation, suggestion and fault reporting
- Appointed safety representatives (where appropriate) and environment representatives (Where appointed).
- Emergency procedures including action following an Incident o details of the occupational health provision onsite
- Restrictions including smoking, drugs and alcohol policies and permits to work.
- Key messages conveyed in site induction shall be reinforced through site hazard information boards, newsletters, videos, toolbox talks and other means.At the Contractors discretion, visitors accompanied at all times by suitably competent personnel, need not complete a full Contractor induction, although they will still require a visitors briefing, where:
- Notundertaking any physicalwork;
- Presence on site isnot interfering with any work,andtheir presence placesneither themselves nor others at any risk.

## 2.4.3.2.3.HSE Leadership Training:

- Third Party accredited HSE leadership training shall be conducted for all managers who are working on Enaa1 Misr Program, inclusive of all subcontractors' managers.
- Content of HSE leadership training is to be agreed by Emaar Misr.

## 2.4.3.2.4. Specialized Training:

- >S Specialized training designed to address specific health and safety requirements will be required to be provided as necessary. Specialized training would include but not be limited to:
- Risk assessment
- Accident investigation
- Working in confined spaces (supervisory and man entry)
- Lifting operations
- Banks men
- Scaffolding
- Use of and changing abrasive wheels
- Operation of machinery such as drills, lathes, circular saws, portable powef toois,ete
